title: Material Stone color tokens
description: The shape of color.yaml. This layer knows about one token at a time: what a name may look like, what a value may look like, and that both modes are written. Everything that needs to compare two tokens — a hex declared twice, a palette entry nothing points at, a semantic token leaning on another — lives in build/lint.ts instead.

name.description: Group and role, both in kebab case: $color.palette.stone-400, $color.state.error, $color.bracket.1.

description.description: Why this token exists, for a reader who can already see its value. Worth writing where the name does not carry the whole reason.

values.description: One value per theme. Both are required: a token that means the same thing in both themes says so by writing the same reference twice, never by leaving a mode out.

value.description: A hex (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) or another token, optionally with a /xx alpha suffix: $color.palette.green-700/60.
